title: Find all anagram start indices
statementMd:
Return the start indices of all substrings of `s` that are anagrams of `p`, ascending.

**Example:** `find_anagrams("cbaebabacd", "abc")` returns `[0, 6]`.
solutionMd:
```python
def find_anagrams(s, p):
    from collections import Counter
    k = len(p)
    need = Counter(p)
    win = Counter(s[:k])
    out = [0] if win == need else []
    for i in range(k, len(s)):
        win[s[i]] += 1
        win[s[i - k]] -= 1
        if win[s[i - k]] == 0:
            del win[s[i - k]]
        if win == need:
            out.append(i - k + 1)
    return out
```

Update the window in O(1) per step.
